title: Sarvam AI co-founder warns India risks becoming a 'digital colony' over dependence on foreign AI
description: Sarvam AI co-founder Vivek Raghavan urged India to develop homegrown AI capabilities to avoid foreign dependence.

title: Cognizant sets up OpenAI Frontier Capability Group to help enterprises deploy AI at scale
description: Cognizant said it is scaling OpenAI across its own sales and customer success operations first, so clients can benefit from approaches tested at enterprise level.

title: Obasanjo Warns AI Could Be Another Western Trap, Says Debt Destroys Generations
description: Obasanjo warns developing countries against blindly adopting Western ideas, questions Nigeria’s debt burden and urges AI solutions to grassroots challenges.

title: Chamet Strengthens Multimodal AI Moderation for Live Video Chat as Singapore’s Online Safety Commission Takes Effect
description: Multi-model risk scoring and multimodal detection of suspected minors help the adults-only platform find and act on harmful content in real time

title: IBS Proposes HK$563 Million Acquisition of AI Chip Enterprise
description: HONG KONG SAR – Media OutReach Newswire – 30 October 2026 – International Business Settlement Holdings Limited (“IBS” or the “Company”, together with its subsidiaries, the “Group”; stock code: 0147.HK) entered into a Share Purchase Agreement with the shareholder of QuantumCompute Solutions Limited (“QuantumCompute Solutions”) to acquire its entire equity interests for a consideration of HK$563 million.
